No actions this turn. I've read the spreadsheet description you pasted, and there's nothing else to look at yet.

---

Your current sheet already records lending: seed, packets, borrower, date out, date back. So the gap seems to be in the "what's come back" half. About a third of the Date back cells are empty, and that one detail could mean very different things.

Seed libraries often work differently from book libraries. People don't usually return the packet they borrowed. They return seeds they saved from their own harvest, sometimes a season later, and sometimes never. If that's how yours works, many of those blanks are normal, and the tool should handle long, open-ended loans and returns that don't match what went out. If borrowers are supposed to bring seeds back by a certain time, the blanks are a follow-up problem, and the tool should flag who's overdue and help you nudge them.

So before I suggest anything:

**When someone borrows seeds from your library, what are they expected to bring back, and by when?**
